Fetch a release of DFO's NuSEDS All Areas file

Source: R/nuseds_fetch.R
knw_nuseds_fetch.Rd

NuSEDS (Fisheries and Oceans Canada's New Salmon Escapement Database System) is published on the Open Government Portal as All Areas NuSEDS_<YYYYMMDD>.zip, one CSV of every salmon population, stream, species and year, under the Open Government Licence - Canada. This finds the release through the portal's CKAN API (ckanr), downloads it once to <dir>/<YYYYMMDD>/, and returns where it is with its md5.

Usage

knw_nuseds_fetch(
  dir = "data/nuseds",
  release = NULL,
  dataset = "c48669a3-045b-400d-b730-48aafe8c5ee6",
  url = "https://open.canada.ca/data/en"
)

Arguments

dir

character(1) the directory releases are kept under.

release

character(1) a release date as YYYYMMDD, or NULL for the newest the record lists.

dataset

character(1) the portal's dataset id for NuSEDS.

url

character(1) the CKAN site.

Value

A list: path (the zip), release (YYYYMMDD), md5, url (where it came from) and fetched (when, UTC), both kept in source.dcf beside the zip when it was downloaded and read back from there when it is held (NA for a zip that has none), and downloaded (TRUE when this call fetched it).

Details

A release already held is never downloaded again or overwritten: a later release is a new directory, so a run names the input it read. Asked for the latest, the function takes the newest release the record lists. The download is refused unless it is a zip holding exactly one CSV, the shape knw_nuseds_records() reads through crate.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- knw_nuseds_fetch()
x$release
} # }
